Team — quick pulse ahead of Thursday's submission window. Short, action-oriented notes so we get a clean commit: 

1) Submission window: Thu 06/20 by 5pm PT. I need final stage changes in HubSpot and the deal evidence uploaded to the Drive pack by 4:30pm so RevOps can validate.

2) Quick rules for updates (please follow exactly):
- ACV (net) in the Amount field, and expected close date set to 2028-06-30 if we intend to commit for Q2.
- Stage must be one of: Proposal, Contract, Legal Review, or Commit. If you're moving to Commit, add a 1–2 line justification in the HubSpot notes.
- Confidence %: set to 40/60/80/95 based on your latest ask and exec involvement (use 95 only if signed docs in-hand).

3) Evidence checklist (attached): signed SOW, procurement contact, procurement timeline, any open redlines, and an explicit unblock list. If Procure has a vendor onboarding step, paste the URL in the Drive folder.

4) 15m alignment call (Thursday 11:15–11:30 PT). Agenda: quick state by lane (3 deals max each), blockers requiring leadership help, and any pricing/terms asks. Calendar invite attached (SprintPad-Agenda.ics).

Marissa — can you run the lane readout? Priyom — please consolidate the legal review queue and flag anything needing EPD/Legal support. Grace — RevOps will need a triage doc from you by 4pm Thursday with the deals you plan to move.

If you can't make the 11:15 slot, ping me with a 1–2 line update and we will call you in if needed. Short replies only.

Thanks,
Mina
